seoTitle: Subscription Cost Tracker: Monthly and Yearly Total
metaDescription: Total all subscriptions per month and year from a pasted list, sorted by cost with each share. Free and private.
intro: Turns a list of subscriptions with different billing cycles into monthly and yearly totals.
why:
Small recurring charges add up. Putting weekly, monthly, quarterly and yearly prices on the same monthly scale shows which ones cost most.

Set a highlight limit to flag items worth reviewing. Nothing is saved: copy your list if you want to keep it.
howTo: Write one line per subscription: name, price, cycle.

faq.a: Weekly, monthly, quarterly, half-yearly and yearly.
Nothing you type leaves your browser.
Only if the price you enter does.
